answer: A durable defense is per-cluster sequential registration. A new identity is grouped with accounts sharing a funding origin, and the cluster must advance a verifiable delay one step before each admission. Steps are not parallelizable, so a thousand clones need a thousand sequential delays, while a thousand independent humans advance their own chains at once. Joining moves at human pace, and cluster height glows like a nebula against dark sky, readable at a glance. Honest clusters grow as a mirror image of their own effort, in order, while bursts stall under latency and never reach zenith.
